versions.changelog:
- Initial release of flutter-dev skill.
- Covers Flutter basics, Material 3 migration, layout constraints, animations (Hero/Staggered), adaptive layouts, platform adaptation, large screen support, state management solutions comparison, persistence, networking, and performance optimization.
- Triggers on a wide range of Flutter, Dart, and mobile development keywords.
- Provides in-depth code samples and best practices for state management (setState, Provider, Riverpod, BLoC), layout constraints, animations, and more.
- References official Flutter documentation for further reading.
